letters.text: I ghosted my best friend of 12 years because I was jealous of her life. It's been 2 years and I think about her every single day.
letters.reply: Two years of thinking about someone every day — that's not a dead friendship, it's a paused one. Jealousy made you run, but missing her this much tells you what matters more. A simple "I'm sorry, I disappeared and I miss you" might be the hardest and best text you'll ever send.

letters.text: 매일 밤 남편이 잠든 후에 울어요. 이혼을 원하는 게 아니라 그냥… 누군가 내 이야기를 들어줬으면 좋겠어요.
letters.reply: 들리고 있어요. 이혼이 아니라 '들어줌'을 원한다는 걸 스스로 아는 것, 그게 이미 중요한 자각이에요. 혼자 우는 밤이 쌓이면 지치니까 — 나만의 시간에 나를 위한 대화를 시작해보는 건 어떨까요?

letters.text: I got promoted last week but I feel nothing. Everyone's congratulating me and I just keep smiling. I think I chose the wrong life.
letters.reply: That emptiness after getting what you wanted? It's not a sign you're broken — it's a signal worth listening to. The "wrong life" feeling usually means one specific thing is off, not everything. What did the version of you before this career actually want?
